title: PosterReward: Unlocking Accurate Evaluation for High-Quality Graphic Design Generation
authors: Jianyu Lai, Sixiang Chen, Jialin Gao, Hengyu Shi, Zhongying Liu, Fuxiang Zhai, Junfeng Luo, Xiaoming Wei, Lujia Wang, Lei Zhu
abstract: Recent advancements in the text-rendering capabilities of image generation models have made the end-to-end creation of graphic design content, such as posters, increasingly feasible. However, existing reward models fall short of accurately assessing design quality, as they primarily focus on global image aesthetics while overlooking the critical dimensions of typography and layout. Furthermore, the scarcity of domain-specific preference data remains a significant bottleneck, which limits the further development of graphic design evaluation and generation. To bridge this gap, we introduce an automated pipeline to construct a high-quality dataset of 70k poster preferences by leveraging the consensus of multiple Multi-modal Large Language Models (MLLMs) to simulate human-like judgment. Utilizing this dataset, we develop PosterReward, a reward model specifically designed for high-precision poster assessment through a cascaded, multi-stage training strategy. We also provide multiple variants of the model to cater to different application scenarios. Finally, we introduce PosterRewardBench and PosterBench to evaluate the performance of existing reward models in poster assessment and the generation capabilities of current text-to-image models in poster creation, respectively.
zh_title: PosterReward：解锁高质量平面设计生成的准确评估
zh_abstract: 图像生成模型在文字渲染能力上的近期进展，使海报等平面设计内容的端到端生成日益可行。然而，现有奖励模型难以准确评估设计质量：它们主要关注图像的整体美学，却忽视了字体排印与版式这两个关键维度；面向该领域的偏好数据稀缺，也制约了平面设计评估与生成的进一步发展。为弥补这一缺口，本文设计了一条自动化数据构建流程，借助多个多模态大语言模型（MLLM）的共识来模拟人类判断，构建了包含 7 万条海报偏好的高质量数据集 Poster-Preference-70K。在此基础上，我们提出 PosterReward——一种通过级联多阶段训练策略实现高精度海报评估的专用奖励模型，并提供多个变体以适配不同应用场景。此外，我们提出 PosterRewardBench 与 PosterBench，分别用于衡量现有奖励模型在海报评估任务上的表现，以及当前文生图模型在海报创作上的生成能力。实验表明，PosterReward 的偏好判断准确性优于现有奖励模型与 MLLM。
